entities.name: Ethyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The encoded reaction converts an ethyl ester, –C(=O)OCH2CH3, to the corresponding carboxylic acid, –C(=O)OH; other identified scaffold features remain unchanged.
The transformation is ester saponification/hydrolysis rather than oxidation, deprotection, or acylation.

entities.name: LiOH dioxane water
observations: Closest matched records use lithium hydroxide in 1,4-dioxane/water for approximately 2 hours and report about 95.4% yield.
Water serves as hydrolysis medium/reagent and dioxane as the organic cosolvent.
